title: epidorkis viridis
intro: Epidorkis viridis, commonly known as Green Epidorkis, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Epidorkis viridis include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
